text_block_list.text:
The ultimate stage where the elite gather: 
the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There, Maruzensky showcased a run that 
made everyone want to chase after her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fulfilling race, she remarked that 
she felt like she could continue to enjoy 
running from here on out.
